independentFinding: Conditionally support admission of this Texas source interpretation under a separately evaluated precision-v2 method. EPPO explicitly evaluates the named Texas jurisdiction as absent with pest eradicated, using information dated 2012 and reporting eradication in 2010. The separately retained APHIS page supplies substantive current corroboration by confining Karnal bunt to Arizona. Together these can support a reviewed current official-status proposal despite the old underlying declaration; new retrieval alone cannot. June 9, 2026 is defensible as a disclosed project eligibility and freshness anchor derived from APHIS page modification metadata, but not as a proven declaration publication day, biological event date, or statement-specific reaffirmation date. This finding does not establish that any county ledger is conflict-free or authorize county assertions.
